title: Roles
description: A worker's role: a default model and effort, a prompt joining its system prompt, and flags the tower reads (whether it hires, whether it is consulted). A hire naming no role can take a default one.

roles.description: The roles a worker can take, by name. A floor's value replaces the system's whole.

model.description: The model a worker in this role starts with, when its spawn names none.

effort.description: The effort it starts with, when its spawn names none.

hires.description: Whether a worker in this role may hire: false refuses its `tower hire`.

consultable.description: Whether `tower x roles advisor` lists workers in this role.

hireDefault.description: The role of a hire that names none, logged on it as if it had named it. Left out, such a hire takes no role and launches as it would without this extension.

roles.prompts.label: Role prompts
roles.prompts.description: One markdown file per role, named by it (`advisor.md`): what a worker in that role does. It joins the system prompt of every worker in the role.

words.label: Role
words.hint: What this worker is for: its default model, effort and prompt

advisor/<project>.description: The workers on duty on the floor whose role is consultable, oldest first, each with its callsign and the name it is messaged as.

peer.description: The name other Claude sessions message it by, while its Claude runs.

guidance.brief: Name a role on each hire (`tower hire x.roles.role <name>`); `tower x roles advisor` says who to consult.
guidance.full:
A role gives a worker its default model and effort and a prompt of what it is for. Name the role on every hire: `tower hire x.roles.role worker <<'EOF'` … `EOF`, the brief on stdin, or `reviewer`, or any role the floor's settings list (the spawn form's Role lists them). A model or effort named on the hire wins over the role's. A hire naming no role takes the floor's default role when it has one.

A worker whose role doesn't hire is refused at `tower hire`, with the reason: bring the work to whoever hires instead.

To consult an advisor, when your role says you may: `tower x roles advisor` lists the advisors on duty on your floor now, oldest first, with the name to message each by. Ask it each time rather than remembering one: advisors are replaced during the day.
